entities.summary: Chimila (Shimizya), also known as Ette Taara, is a Chibchan language of Colombia, spoken by the Chimila people, who live between the lower Magdalena River, the Sierra Nevada de Santa Maria and the Cesar River. At one time Chimila was grouped with the Malibu languages, but then Chimila became classified as a Chibchan language.
